theme: Ocean Blue, White, Aqua - Professional Fish Market Style

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure fonts are imported via Google Fonts. 'Baloo 2' gives a fresh, slightly rounded friendly look compatible with Devanagari. 'Mukta' handles dense Marathi/English UI text with excellent clarity. 'Khand' for punchy pricing and number displays.

customer_facing.header: Sticky with Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/50). Must include GSN Logo, live date/time, and Open/Close status badge.
customer_facing.hero: Full width rounded-b-3xl container. Use ocean wave texture or seafood market image with heavy dark blue gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Include Welcome message in Marathi & English.
customer_facing.grid: Bento-style or neat e-commerce grid for fish cards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4. gap-6 lg:gap-8.
customer_facing.footer: Deep blue (#03396C) background. py-16. Minimalist links, map integration, and contact info.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (left) + Main Content (right) with a strict grid hierarchy.
admin_dashboard.cards: Dense, crisp borders (border-slate-200), flat white background. Avoid heavy shadows here to keep it functional.
admin_dashboard.table: Shadcn UI table style, minimal borders, clear stock toggle buttons.

visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle border-slate-200 for normal cards. On hover, change border to border-aqua/50.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient smooth shadows on fish cards: hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,168,232,0.12)].
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for badges and floating buttons.

fish_card.description: Clean white card. Top 50% is the fish image. Bottom 50% contains English + Marathi name, Price/Kg, and Availability badge.
fish_card.styling: bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-100 transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl group relative

floating_action_buttons.description: Bottom right corner stacked buttons: WhatsApp (Green), Phone (Primary Blue), Map (Aqua). Must have pulsating animation or subtle bounce.
floating_action_buttons.styling: fixed bottom-6 right-6 flex flex-col gap-4 z-50

status_badge.description: Indicates if shop is OPEN (Green) or CLOSED (Red) today.
status_badge.styling: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white shadow-sm

motion.hover: Scale images slightly on card hover (group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up for fish cards using Framer Motion.
motion.buttons: Active state scale-95. Floating WhatsApp button should have a subtle ping/pulse effect.

hero_backgrounds.description: Mysterious dark ocean surface - great for hero background under text
Vibrant seafood market stall - use as alternative hero or about section

fish_placeholders.description: Top view of two fresh raw fish on a white marble surface

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on primary blue has at least 4.5:1 contrast. Use black/dark-slate for text on white cards.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="buy-whatsapp-btn"`, `data-testid="fish-card-surmai"`).
accessibility.language: Ensure proper lang tags and semantic HTML for screen readers reading Marathi.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide React for icons (e.g., Phone, MessageCircle/WhatsApp, MapPin, Clock, Fish).
Implement the customer site and admin dashboard in the same application using React Router.
Ensure the hero section overlay (bg-black/40 or bg-[#03396C]/70) makes the white Marathi/English welcome text pop.
Do not use generic 'Inter'. Import 'Baloo 2', 'Mukta', and 'Khand' from Google Fonts and apply them via Tailwind config.
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. No custom CSS unless absolutely necessary.
Build Shadcn-compatible components but style them according to these guidelines (e.g., remove excessive borders, add soft rounded corners).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for the header and floating menus.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Let the layout breathe naturally.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
